en: Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet lakeside or riverside scene. In the foreground there is calm water with a small wooden rowboat tied to a post. The far bank is lined with rocks and a gently sloping shore leading up to dense trees and bushes. A small boathouse or shed stands near the waterline. The photo has a wide white border, rounded corners, and visible wear and creases consistent with vintage postcards. No text is clearly visible on the image side.
